PROCEDURE DRIVE_INFORMATION IS
d_date date;
found varchar2(1) := 'N';

BEGIN
 GO_BLOCK('schedules_blk');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 FIRST_RECORD;
 d_date := to_date(:control_blk.from_date,'MM-DD-RR'); 

LOOP ---Start LOOP for dates between from date AND to date
 IF d_date > to_date(:control_blk.to_date,'MM-DD-RR') THEN
 exit;
 ELSE
 declare
 cursor C1 is
 SELECT dr.drive_date dr_date, to_char(dr.drive_date,'Dy') week_day,
 ssd.drive_id drive, ssd.job_code, ssd.special_job_code , 
 ssd.actual_bod, ssd.actual_eod, ssd.comments
 from drives dr, staff_schedule_details ssd
 where ssd.staff_no = :control_blk.staff_no 
 and ssd.schedule_id = :control_blk.schedule_id 
 and ssd.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and dr.drive_id = ssd.drive_id 
 and dr.chapter_id = ssd.chapter_id 
 and dr.drive_date = d_date
 UNION
 SELECT sod.unavail_date dr_date, to_char(sod.unavail_date,'Dy') week_day,
 sod.reason drive, ' ' job_code, ' ' special_job_code , 
 sod.from_time actual_bod, sod.to_time actual_eod, sod.comments
 from staff_off_day sod
 where sod.staff_no = :control_blk.staff_no 
 and sod.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and sod.unavail_date = d_date
 ORDER BY 6, 7;
 BEGIN
 found := 'N' ; 
 FOR c1rec IN c1 LOOP --Start LOOP for DRIVES on particular date
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.drive_date := c1rec.dr_date;
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.week_day := c1rec.week_day;
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.drive_id := c1rec.drive ;
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.comments := c1rec.comments ;

 if (c1rec.special_job_code = 'VDRVR') then
 :schedules_blk.driver_typ := 'Van';
 elsif (c1rec.special_job_code = 'CDRVR') then
 :schedules_blk.driver_typ := 'Coach';
 else
 :schedules_blk.driver_typ := c1rec.special_job_code ;
 end if;

 :SCHEDULES_BLK.job_cd := c1rec.job_code;

 IF substr(c1rec.drive,1,3) = 'DRV' THEN
 check_piggy_drive (c1rec.drive,piggy_flag, piggy_actual_bod, piggy_actual_eod);
 IF piggy_flag = 'Y' THEN
 IF c1rec.actual_bod <= piggy_actual_bod THEN
 IF piggy_actual_bod <= c1rec.actual_bod THEN
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_bod := piggy_actual_bod;
 ELSE
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_bod := c1rec.actual_bod;
 END IF;
 IF piggy_actual_eod >= c1rec.actual_eod THEN
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_eod := piggy_actual_eod;
 ELSE
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_eod := c1rec.actual_eod;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_bod := '';
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_eod := '';
 END IF;
 ELSE
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_bod := c1rec.actual_bod;
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_eod := c1rec.actual_eod;
 END IF;
 
 BEGIN
 select initcap(a.name), a.sponsor_id
 into :schedules_blk.sponsor_name, :schedules_blk.sponsor_id
 from sponsors a, drive_sponsors b
 where b.drive_id = :schedules_blk.drive_id 
 and a.sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id 
 and rownum=1;
 EXCEPTION 
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 END;
 ELSE
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_bod := c1rec.actual_bod;
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_eod := c1rec.actual_eod;
 END IF;

 :schedules_blk.hours := round((:schedules_blk.actual_eod - :schedules_blk.actual_bod)*24*60);
 :schedules_blk.hours := lpad(trunc(:schedules_blk.hours/60),2,'0')||':'||lpad(mod(:schedules_blk.hours,60),2,'0');

 found := 'Y';
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END LOOP; --End LOOP for DRIVES on particular date

 IF found = 'N' THEN
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.drive_date := d_date;
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.week_day := to_char(d_date,'Dy');
 
 BEGIN
/**
 SELECT reason 
 INTO :schedules_blk.drive_id
 FROM STAFF_OFF_DAY
 WHERE unavail_date = d_date
 AND staff_no = :control_blk.staff_no ;
 EXCEPTION when no_data_found then
**/
 :schedules_blk.drive_id := 'Not Assigned'; 
 END;
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END IF;
 d_date := d_date + 1 ;

 END;
 END IF;
END LOOP; ---End LOOP for dates between from date AND to date

first_record;
don_mcal_common.staff_weekly_hours(:control_blk.schedule_id,:control_blk.staff_no,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :control_blk.tot_hrs );
END;
